stories.story_fr: Le segment Wholesale (banque d'investissement et marches) a porte son PNB a 290,5 Md JPY au trimestre clos en decembre 2024, en hausse de plus de 50% sur six trimestres, moteur principal du rebond de Nomura.
stories.story_en: The Wholesale segment (investment banking and markets) lifted net revenue to JPY 290.5B in the quarter ended December 2024, up more than 50% over six quarters, the main engine of Nomura's rebound.

stories.story_fr: Sur neuf mois clos en decembre 2024, le resultat net part du groupe a bondi de 146% a 268,8 Md JPY, avec un ROE annualise passe de 4,5% a 10,4%.
stories.story_en: For the nine months ended December 2024, net income attributable to shareholders surged 146% to JPY 268.8B, with annualized ROE rising from 4.5% to 10.4%.
stories.quote: Net income attributable to NHI shareholders 268,766 146.3 Return on shareholders' equity - annualized 10.4%

stories.story_fr: Le segment Wealth Management (ex-Retail) a vu son PNB croitre regulierement a 116,3 Md JPY au trimestre clos en decembre 2024 contre 92,1 Md JPY 18 mois plus tot, signe d'une collecte d'actifs soutenue.
stories.story_en: The Wealth Management segment (formerly Retail) grew net revenue steadily to JPY 116.3B in the quarter ended December 2024 from JPY 92.1B eighteen months earlier, reflecting sustained asset gathering.

stories.story_fr: Les commissions de banque d'investissement ont progresse de 27% sur neuf mois a 159,0 Md JPY clos en decembre 2024, portees par l'activite de marches de capitaux.
stories.story_en: Investment banking fees rose 27% over nine months to JPY 159.0B for the period ended December 2024, driven by capital markets activity.

stories.story_fr: Nomura a signe la vente d'un actif immobilier a Takanawa (Tokyo) generant un resultat avant impots d'environ 56 Md JPY attendu au T4 FY25 ou T1 FY26, un gain ponctuel notable.
stories.story_en: Nomura agreed to sell a Takanawa (Tokyo) real estate asset expected to book pre-tax income of about JPY 56B in Q4 FY25 or Q1 FY26, a notable one-off gain.
stories.quote: income before income taxes of approximately 56 billion yen is expected to be booked
